scope.inventoryMethod: Executed finite Dart catalogs plus reviewed route dispatch, authority sources and import graph. File hashes fix the actual source snapshot.
scope.inventoryEntrySemantics: The compatibility field 'routes' contains reviewed inventory entries: active/conditional screens, navigation, contracts, protected routes, and inactive legacy paths. Its length is not a count of currently reachable assessed tasks.
scope.protected: Writing trainer and journal internals; outer adapters only.
scope.nonCurriculumGames: Memory, Connect Four, Dice Race and Star Trail retain game rules/rewards; no independent curriculum-answer task is claimed here.
scope.parallelOwnership: Integrated Root snapshot. Delivered owner and Root checkpoints are recorded separately from their test logs and final release/device gates. No foreign worktree WIP is silently treated as delivered source.
scope.persistedIds: Existing catalog IDs are copied unchanged. Inventory route IDs/sourceIndex are documentation keys, not new storage identifiers.

core.description: Existing local task answer/evaluator feeds TaskResult, adaptive/reward/feedback engines and profile-bound app recording. Renderer callbacks do not create a second progress store.

module.evaluation: Each specialist screen compares against its current local task; see its route source.
module.description: Existing queued profile-owner saves, retry without duplicate reward, separate assisted/discovery evidence and completion bonus.

plus10.description: Existing custom owner-bound answer/reward and finish-retry path, not LearningModuleProgress.

crossGrade.description: Local answer comparison; first incorrect attempt gets a second chance. Separate practice namespace, no enrolled-grade, XP or wallet mutation.

activity.description: Practical instructions with an existing manual Journal entry, plus linked digital practice/workshops where available. Observation is human; this screen deliberately has no automatic correctness, school-result submission or rewards.

lab.description: Local model/answer checks. Building records assisted observation; recall/transfer use existing module progress. Reflection is not an extra correct answer.

guided.description: Step-specific deterministic acceptance, guided/independent evidence distinct; discovery has separate progress and no school/wallet rewards.

reading.description: Accepted speech attempt ledger drives reading progress; ambiguous recognition must not be treated as a proven deficit. Microphone/runtime-device QA remains open.

readingBuddy.description: Reading participation and local comprehension answers are separate; the existing comprehension correctIndex and module progress remain authoritative.

story.description: Existing page exercises, whole-book comprehension and summary evaluation; completion and summary rewards retain existing exactly-once storage rules.

photo.description: OCR prepares checked tasks. PhotoLessonPracticeScreen accepts actual answers through the existing renderer/domain boundary and queues the profile-owned session/evidence. Revealing a solution or an unconfirmed speech proposal is not a correct answer.

iq.description: Existing local puzzle session and repository. No claim of standardized diagnostic validation.

cognitive.description: Existing five-domain local profile scoring. No claim of standardized diagnostic validation.

gameLevel.description: Each mini-game checks its own task and saves its level result. Keep level IDs and existing game rewards distinct from school mastery.

cards.description: Current-grade Denkpause answer checked by existing card controller. Grades 1/2 use bundles; grades 3/4 use checked math templates.

quiz.description: Existing answer lock/reveal, jokers, round ownership and one-time game reward. Native table is a presentation path for the same round.

flame.description: Existing exact choice comparison for question blocks and three-answer chest streak; own game reward ledger. This is the 2D Flame learning game, not the excluded native Jungle.

live.description: Word/photo participation rewards and heuristic safari speech matching are existing behavior; they are not reliable independently assessed subject mastery.

protectedWriting.description: Existing writing evaluator/progress and journal internals remain untouched. Only outer routing/adapters may be added.

none.description: Navigation, reference or conversational support; not an independently assessed task.

gaps.description: Visible task-bound native entries and canonical handoffs are implemented. Many tasks use an exact generic task_card; dedicated spatial manipulatives are not supplied for every family. Targeted mocked-native tests are distinct from complete physical-device/actor interaction proof.
No current Android/Fold hardware, rotation, audio/mic, large text and 60 FPS sweep across all routes. Widget tests are not hardware proof.
Neutral prompt-derived cards; the recorded three-case privacy regression covers assessment and hidden-solution mutation. Its executionSourceCommit remains separate from the newest export HEAD.

All eight subjects of the 236 catalog families have hub definitions and current-grade unit cards. Loaded Core tasks use the common coach/native entry; specialist/protected dispatch takes precedence where mapped. This is shared workflow coverage, not 236 individually specialized and exhaustively exercised workspaces.

The canonical bus validates task identity, allowed actions, exam policy and named objects. Proposals remain ungraded until explicit owner confirmation. Existing deterministic checks partly reside in renderer/screen code; that file organization is not missing AI/native authority isolation or a reward API.

Lesen and Rechtschreibung have actual hub subject entries and normal unit cards. Active speech reading is an additional button. Exact unit dispatch exists; no claim that every one of the 236 family selections and generated variants has been executed in a UI tour.

18 active specialist screens / 19 Academy routes: 17 ModuleTaskScope screens plus Plus10; current-task help, visible editable candidate, explicit confirmation and native task_card entry. All current screen hashes match the 134-test delivery manifest.

All 60 practical entries include a reachable Journal observation link; some also link checked digital practice or a native workshop. Automatic physical-observation grading and a formal teacher-submission workflow are not implemented or claimed; manual observation is intentional.

All six Lab modes, including the pattern workbench, now have a visible native button for their exact current task_card. The 24-test Lab run checks six entries, pause/return, ungraded candidates, Stop and per-problem assistance. This generic card is not a specialized native pattern manipulative; the separate checked pattern adapter uses period/sequence/choices.
Separate Godot activity exists; no inline native platform view in every Flutter task.

Recorded tests cover Core/Guided native return, all 19 module entries, Lab native lifecycle, Reading/Photo and the delivered Live/Flame/question coach. The added 24/35/56-test runs are targeted evidence, not a final full-Root or physical microphone result.

Only the older Flutter LearningSceneDirector contract declares placeValue alone. The separate current NativeLearningActivity adapter has 12 descriptor kinds including task_card. The older enum is neither an unconnected current route nor a system-wide one-scene limit; visual enums still do not establish specialized native scenes.
Recognition permission, mishearing/correction, stop/pause and actual audio playback require current runtime proof.

Story reader, tasks and scoped coach are integrated. Dynamic stored/generated stories cannot be inferred exhaustively from the finite quest catalog; this is a verification boundary, not a missing story connection.

PhotoLessonPracticeScreen checks actual responses, supports confirmed proposals and profile-owned resumable sessions; scanning/reveal alone grants no correct answer. Its direct native entry is included in the recorded 35-test joined run; final exact-source/device verification remains separate.

Current learning coaches have canonical task bindings. This legacy inventory entry describes the final Teacher topic-chat fallback: current unit/tool callers do not reach it, and it has no local scored-task/result/reward path. It does not establish an active assessed task without a binding.

Delivered Live confirmation keeps the existing word/photo participation and safari matching policy. These records are intentionally distinct from independently verified curriculum mastery; the distinction is not an unimplemented coach connection.
Writing trainer and journal internals preserved; no claim of internal modernization.
Legacy gap bank has multiple sensible options: Hund spielt im Haus/Garten; Vogel sitzt auf dem Tisch/Ast. It was not reconnected.
Unreachable legacy gap screen directly records/rewards; profile-owner and assisted-evidence integration needs review before enabling it.
